up: Retrieve all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL2163248'. For each compound, return the following columns: the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), the preferred name (pref_name), the maximum phase of clinical development (max_phase), the molecule type (molecule_type), and the canonical SMILES string (canonical_smiles). Join the documents table using the ChEMBL ID to identify the document, then join the compound records to link to the molecule dictionary for metadata and the compound structures table for the SMILES. Do not apply any filters on confidence scores, assay types, or other metadata unless explicitly requested. Return all matching compounds without row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2163248'
